# Media index

Console videos are recorded by hand and uploaded to GitHub (`user-attachments`) at each MINOR release. The URL is noted
here, with the version it belongs to; `assert_media_index_current` keeps a MINOR release in draft until this file cites its
version and a `github.com/user-attachments` URL.

| Version | Video | URL |
|---|---|---|
| 1.0.0 | Console demo (recorded on fixtures) | not uploaded yet (needs the demo mode, task 3.11, moved to 1.1, and a human upload) |
